portal_hypertension.title: Laparoscopic or Open Liver Resection Versus Multibipolar Radiofrequency Ablation of HCC Within Milan Criteria on Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Multicenter Study / Comparative Study
portal_hypertension.authors: Hobeika C, Cauchy F, Rode A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究。核心观点：使用多变量回归对 HCC 大小/数量、性别、年龄、ASA、HCV、HBV、代谢综合征、慢性酒精摄入、MELD 评分、血清 AFP 水平、APRI 评分、肝硬化、显着门脉高压和 HCC 定位进行调整 临床提示：我们对米兰境内 HCC 患者的多极射频消融 (mbpRFA) 与开腹肝切除术 (OLR) 或腹腔镜肝切除术 (LLR) 进行了比较。
portal_hypertension.abstract: We compared multibipolar radiofrequency ablation (mbpRFA) with open liver resection (OLR) or laparoscopic liver resection (LLR) in patients with HCCs within Milan. This multicenter cohort study included patients treated by mbpRFA, OLR or LLR for HCC within the Milan Criteria, developed on advanced fibrosis in nine French centres between 2008 and 2018.
